name: Monster Moto 80 / 212
engine: 79 to 212 cc air-cooled small-engine single, pull start, centrifugal clutch
intro: Mini bikes sold through big-box stores. Small horizontal-shaft engines and simple frames.

L: These use a small horizontal-shaft engine like a lawnmower's. Engine parts are cheap and common; check the governor, the clutch or torque converter and the chain guard.

recallNote: Many of these were sold under several brand names and may not show up in the NHTSA search. Check with the seller or importer for open recalls.
